# podé / pudé / pudé

## Infinitive

| Dialett | Italiano | English |
|---|---|---|
| **podé / pudé / pudé** | potere | to be able to |

| pudendo | pudüü | 2nd conjugation: infinitive in -é (Italian -ere, stressed ending) |
